note: Declared LLM call sites. Registered into LightTrack via `lt use-cases register`; the gap between this declaration and observed events.name is the coverage report.

use_cases.name: Multi-step web research agent
use_cases.description: Runs an open-ended, multi-turn web research session to answer a query, resuming the same model session across steps until the answer converges or the budget is spent.

use_cases.name: Connector API diff summarizer
use_cases.description: Summarizes an added/removed-lines diff of a watched API's public documentation into a developer-facing change summary with tags and severity.

use_cases.name: Homewyse pricing extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured trade job pricing bands (low/median/high by locality and unit) from web research into a fixed pricing schema.

use_cases.name: Data source discovery
use_cases.description: Identifies the best public web pages that carry the data needed for a provisioning goal, along with expected fields and update cadence.

use_cases.name: Provisioning rule set drafting
use_cases.description: Drafts (and revises, on dry-run failure) a full data-source rule set proposal as structured JSON, resuming the same session across revisions.

use_cases.name: State contractor licensing extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured state-by-state contractor licensing requirements (bonds, fees, thresholds) for a given trade into a fixed licensing schema.

use_cases.name: State tax rate extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured state income tax rates and top-bracket thresholds for all 50 states + DC into a fixed tax schema.

use_cases.name: Trade wage extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured entry/experienced hourly and annual wage figures per trade, and proposes new trade-label mappings against existing trades.

use_cases.name: Business valuation multiples extraction
use_cases.description: Extracts structured SDE and revenue valuation multiples per trade into a fixed multiples schema.
